newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's CPC to build more oil storage tanks.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's CPC to build more oil storage tanks.

text.p: Sri Lankan state oil company Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) said on Wednesday it would soon have to build additional oil storage tanks to cope with growing consumer and industrial demand for oil.

CPC Chairman Anil Obeyesekere said the company's main complex of 225,000 tonnes of crude and oil products tanks, which was being rebuilt near the capital Colombo following an attack by rebel Tamil Tigers in 1995, would soon be insufficient.
"We are expecting, with the growth of trade, to be having problems with storage as time goes on. We haven't made room for the expanded growth," he told Reuters in an interview.
"Areas have not been identified but certainly we will have to look forward to extra storage facilities, but as to where and when has not been decided yet."
Obeyesekere told Reuters earlier on Wednesday the oil tanks near Colombo would be rebuilt by the end of 1999.
